name: Sign In
ucs: Sign In with Password, Sign In with Google
note: On the mobile app the first field is E-mail only and the screen has no navigation bar.
elements: Switch between signing in and registering. The active tab is highlighted.
Sign in to start your journey!
Required, at most 255 characters. The server accepts the e-mail address only. A message in red appears under the field when it is empty.
Required. The text is hidden and can be shown with a button.
Checks the form, then signs in (UC Sign In with Password). A wrong e-mail or password, an inactive account and a wait after many failures each show a message and the form shakes.
Signs in with a Google account (UC Sign In with Google). A failure shows "Cannot sign in with Google. Please try again."

name: Register
note: The mobile screen also has an optional phone number field and shows a hint of at least 6 characters, while the server needs at least 8.
elements: Switch between signing in and registering.
Create an account to start your journey
Required, must be a valid e-mail address.
Required, 8 to 72 characters. The server also refuses common passwords, passwords that repeat the name or e-mail, and passwords that are too simple, and shows the reason under the field.
Required, must be the same as the password.
Creates the Learner account and sends the verification e-mail (UC Sign Up).
Registers or signs in with Google (UC Sign In with Google).

name: Verify E-mail
elements: Shown while the link in the e-mail is being checked.
Success: the address is confirmed. Failure: "The verification link is not valid or has expired", or "The verification link is incomplete. Open the correct link in the e-mail."
Goes to the Sign In screen after a result.
You can send the link again from the profile page after you sign in.
Hint under a failed result. The page itself has no field to ask for a new link.

name: Forgot Password
elements: Forgot password > Verify e-mail > Reset password
Shows which step of the recovery the user is on.
Forgot your password? Recover it fast!
Sends the request. The message "Request sent" is the same whether or not the address exists (UC Reset Forgotten Password). If sending fails: "Could not send the request. Try again."

name: Reset Password
elements: Heading. The text under it asks for the code and the new password.
Required. Filled in from the link in the e-mail, or pasted by the user.
Required, 8 to 72 characters; the same rules as when registering.
Required, must be the same as the new password.
Saves the new password and closes the other sessions. A code that is wrong, used or older than 15 minutes shows a message.

name: Welcome
ucs: Sign Up, Sign In with Password
elements: Learn step by step. Keep the rhythm every day.
Opens Onboarding for a new user.

name: Onboarding
elements: Progress bar and step counter, for example 2/6. The back arrow returns to the earlier question.
One question at a time: target band (5.5 to 7.5+), the first skill to improve, daily minutes (5 to 20), why the user studies IELTS, earlier exams, and when to remind.
Answer options; exactly one can be chosen.
Disabled until an option is chosen. After the last question the answers are saved on the phone and the app opens Register.

name: Home
ucs: View Plans and Pricing, Browse Examiners
elements: Hero: mascot and "One step a day. Closer to your target band."
Welcome banner of the public site.
Learning benefits: four skills towards the IELTS goal
Section that introduces the four skills Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.
Shows the plans (Premium) and the point cards, and how to enter an activation key. A message appears when the current plan cannot be loaded. The button opens the Activate Key window.
A form with full name and phone number, button "Send request". After sending: "Consultation request sent! An adviser will contact you within 24 hours."

name: Activate Key window
note: The window opens over the Home page, the plan page and the overview.
elements: Enter the full code you were given, with the prefix IP- if there is one. You do not pay here.
Explanation under the title "Activate plan / Top up key".
Required. Example: IP-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. A Guest sees "Sign in to activate a plan or top up points" and a Sign In button instead of the field.
Sends the code (UC Activate Key). Messages: key unknown, used, revoked or expired; e-mail not verified; "The result could not be confirmed. Keep the code and try again when the connection is stable."
Closes the window. After success the window shows "Activation successful" with the points or days granted, and a Done button.

name: Examiner Directory
elements: Learn with the most dedicated IELTS experts
Experts, Highest band, Certificates, Taking work
Filter by skill. A switch limits the list to Examiners who are taking work now.
Highest band, Most experienced, Name A-Z.

One card for each Examiner: name, expertise, graded essays, response time and a Taking work badge. "View profile" opens Examiner Detail. With no match: "No suitable expert found" and a Clear filter button.
Four steps to work with an expert
Explains the process: take the free placement test, choose an expert, send the Writing essay, read the review.

name: Examiner Detail
ucs: Browse Examiners, Request Examiner Review of Essay
elements: Name, photo and short introduction of the Examiner.
Degrees and certificates, areas of teaching, and the "verified" mark.
Four-criterion diagnosis (TR, CC, LR, GRA), inline error tags, band-up rewrites, and automatic update of the knowledge tree and the review basket. A sample feedback sheet is shown.
Starts the request for a review by this Examiner (UC Request Examiner Review of Essay). A Guest is sent to Sign In.

name: Home tab
elements: The published vocabulary topics. While loading: "Loading topics…". With none: "No vocabulary topics yet. Topics appear after they are published." On error: "Could not load vocabulary topics. Check the connection to the server and try again." and a Retry button.

name: Overview
elements: Overview / Detailed data / My achievements / My profile
Switches between the pages of the overview. Detailed data and achievements have their own rows below.
Shows the progress of the chosen course and the start, current and target band.
Course progress, the study streak with the record, and the time learned this week.
Skills of the course: the band of each skill and which one to improve first. With none graded: "No skill has been graded in this course yet."
Visible while a retake is left. Shows the retakes available.

name: Detailed Statistics
elements: Let us look at your detailed data again!
Heading: every learning step is recorded.
Legend and filter of the band chart.
Chart and table of the band of each eligible attempt: date, source and version, with the change from the earlier one. A grade that is being regraded is marked.
Progress by level over the words of IELTSPath.

name: Achievements
note: The mobile screen is called Learning progress and shows the same blocks in one column.
elements: Heading. Text: collect experience, keep the rhythm, unlock new milestones.
Level and experience points, hearts left, and the study streak.
Badges earned and still to earn.
Goes back to the learning path.

name: Profile and Security
ucs: Edit Profile, Change Password, Set Learning Goal
elements: Avatar - click or drop to change
Change or remove the picture. A failed upload shows "Upload failed".
Used to count the study day and the streak.
Edit mode saves with "Saved successfully!". An invalid phone number shows "The phone number is not in the Vietnam format (for example 0912345678 or +84912345678)."
Shows "E-mail not verified yet" and a button to send the verification e-mail again; a failure shows "Could not send the verification e-mail. Try again in a few minutes."
Decides who can see the profile and the learning activity.
A strength meter shows Very weak, Weak, Medium or Strong.
Saves it and shows "Password changed successfully!".
Removes the Google sign-in when the account has a password; a Google-only account must first create a password after confirming with Google.

name: Notification Preferences
elements: You can turn each kind of notice on or off. All are on by default.
Post comments / Replies / Mentions / Reactions / New followers
Premium activated / Premium ending / Result ready / Words due for review
Account and learning notices for the learner.
Essay to grade / Due soon / Overdue / Grade ready
Notices that go to Examiners, in their own group.

name: Account / Profile tab
elements: Shows the user name and e-mail. A Guest sees "Sign in to sync the profile" with a Sign In button.
Choose the XP goal for each day.
Study reminder / Streak reminder / Background music
Help and clearing the cache; clearing asks for confirmation.
Closes the session on the phone (UC Sign Out).

name: Edit Profile
elements: Avatar (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB)
Square, clear pictures are best. "Remove current picture" removes it.
Shown but cannot be changed here.
Band the learner believes they have.
Default Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh; counts the study day and the streak.
Lets other learners see the community profile.

name: Change Password
note: The hint says at least 6 characters, but the server requires at least 8 and refuses weak passwords.
elements: Required: confirms who is changing it.

name: Notifications
elements: Notices are grouped by time. With none: "No notifications yet. When someone likes, comments or follows you, you will see it here."
Tapping a notice opens the post or the screen it is about. An error shows "Could not load notifications" and a Retry button.
